messages:
Alex (CEO): Quick weekly leadership bridge — TL;DR: 1) Dedicated GA next month; 2) cost per 1k tokens down 12% MoM; 3) one reliability hit last week, root cause identified. Please read and action.
Maya (VP Product): Thanks — big congrats to the launch teams. Two asks: confirm GA checklist items completed (docs, SDK samples, billing mapping), and final canary schedule by EOD Wed. Link to checklist: https://go/redwood/dedicated-ga-checklist :rocket:
Sam (VP Eng): Working with infra on canary schedule. Current blocker: a memory regression on 4096-seq runs with the new kernel selection. Patch queued, test run scheduled tonight. Ops will throttle canary to 10% traffic until validated.
Rachel (CFO): Financial note: committed revenue projection for Dedicated is +$1.2M ARR run-rate if we hit GA targets. Cost-saving highlight: Optimize suggestions from Redwood Optimize are shaving GPU token cost by ~12% — need retention plan for those settings.
Jamie (Head of People): Heads up — no new hiring approvals for IC roles outside critical path until next fiscal review (2 weeks). This is temporary and aimed at preserving runway while we validate Dedicated bookings. People-systems will push updated hiring template. @sam please share critical roles list.
Alex (CEO): Priorities this week (owner in parens): 1) GA readiness and docs (Maya), 2) Canary and rollback plan (Sam), 3) Sales enablement + pricing sheet (Rachel & GTM), 4) Customer beta feedback triage + SLA draft (Support/Product).
Maya (VP Product): For docs: we need 3 quick how-tos — onboard, sizing guide, troubleshooting KV cache issues. Volunteers: @rachel for pricing copy, @sam for sizing numbers.
Sam (VP Eng): Canary config snippet we'll use: ```
canary:
  percent: 10
  models: ["redwood-dedicated-v1","redwood-dedicated-v1-quant"]
  fallback: "hosted-economy-v2"
  monitor: ["latency_p50","error_rate"]
```
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/rollout for redwood-dedicated-v1 at 2023-09-14T02:00:00Z (CI: pass).
Rachel (CFO): KPI snapshot to note for execs: MRR change +6% WoW, Gross Margin on hosted stable at 72%, Dedicated early bookings $85k MRR in pipeline. Need final pricing approval Thurs.
Alex (CEO): Risk & mitigation: Risk — canary uncovers perf regression => Mitigation — automatic rollback policy + capacity fallback to hosted. Owners: Sam and SRE on-call.
Jamie (Head of People): Quick pulse ask: leadership sync with managers Fri 9am PT to explain temporary hiring guardrails and answer Qs. I'll send calendar invite.
Maya (VP Product): Customer ask — ensure we have a plan for high-cost token usage detection and alerts communicated in the docs.
Sam (VP Eng): Noted. We'll add cost alerts to the canary monitor and a runtime flag to force low-cost mode.
Alex (CEO): Final: twoBehavioral asks — 1) if you see critical blockers, call me directly, not just the thread; 2) flag any docs gaps by EOD Tue. Appreciate the focus — big week. :eyes: :muscle:
Maya (VP Product): Thanks all. I'll post the GA checklist status update here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Rachel (CFO): I'll circulate the pricing sheet by lunchtime Thu for sign-off.
Jamie (Head of People): Invite sent for Fri manager sync.
Sam (VP Eng): Patch landed to canary branch, running tests now. Will update on failures.
Alex (CEO): Closing out — please react with :white_check_mark: once your owner items are green.
Maya (VP Product): :white_check_mark:
Sam (VP Eng): :white_check_mark: (tests running)
Rachel (CFO): :white_check_mark: (pricing in flight)
Jamie (Head of People): :white_check_mark: (invite sent)
